ui.desc: Rotate all roots about the origin by turns full revolutions: z * exp(i*2*pi*turns).

params.title: Rotation in full turns (1 = 360 degrees). Finite real number.

ui.desc: Pull each root radially toward the unit circle: r' = r - alpha*d*exp(-(d/sigma)^2) with d = r-1. Angles unchanged.

params.title: Gaussian width of the pull around |z| = 1. Finite real number.
Pull strength: 1 snaps nearby roots onto the circle, 0 is identity. Finite real number.

ui.label: Cayley
ui.desc: Cayley transform w = i*(1+z)/(1-z): unit circle maps to the real line, disk interior to the upper half-plane. The pole at z = 1 is clipped.

ui.label: inverse Cayley
ui.desc: Inverse Cayley transform z = (w-i)/(w+i): real line maps to the unit circle, upper half-plane to the disk. The pole at w = -i is clipped.

ui.label: 1/z
ui.desc: Complex inversion z' = 1/z: swaps the inside and outside of the unit circle. The pole at z = 0 is clipped.

ui.label: z+(a+ib)
ui.desc: Translate every root by the constant re + i*im.

params.title: Real part of the translation. Finite real number.
Imaginary part of the translation. Finite real number.

ui.label: z*(a+ib)
ui.desc: Multiply every root by the constant re + i*im (scale and rotate).

params.title: Real part of the multiplier. Finite real number.
Imaginary part of the multiplier. Finite real number.

ui.desc: Real-coefficient Moebius transform z' = (a*z + b)/(c*z + d). Roots where c*z + d = 0 are clipped.

params.title: Numerator z coefficient. Finite real number.
Denominator z coefficient. Finite real number.

ui.desc: Gaussian radial shrink toward the origin: r' = r * (1 - alpha*exp(-(r/sigma)^2)). Angles unchanged.

params.title: Shrink strength at the origin: 1 collapses central roots, 0 is identity. Finite real number.
Gaussian radius of the shrink region. Finite real number.
